responsibility: Implements 32-bit ARM ABI lowering for `FnAbi`, selecting between base AAPCS and hard-float VFP homogeneous aggregate rules, extending small integers, coercing eligible aggregates into integer or floating-point register shapes, and leaving larger returns indirect.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/arm.rs`, this ARM file handles function-call ABI classification, including AAPCS vs hard-float VFP aggregate passing and integer extension, rather than exposing inline-assembly registers, aliases, overlap rules, and Thumb/frame-pointer validation.
